# Compare Power Developer APIs

> Real-time electricity pricing and ESIID lookups for the Texas deregulated market. 12 public REST endpoints across 2 base URLs. No authentication, no rate limits, no cost.

## Full API Specification

- [Complete API spec for LLMs](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/llms-full.txt): All 12 endpoints with parameters, example requests, example responses, warnings, and integration guides. Start here.

## Documentation

- [Developer Overview](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers): Getting started, quick examples, and partner program info
- [API Reference](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/reference): All endpoints with interactive playground
- [Core Concepts](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/concepts): TDSPs, ESI IDs, plans, pricing components, and document links
- [TDSP Reference](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/tdsp-reference): All 6 TDSP DUNS codes and service territories

## Guides

- [Plan Comparison Guide](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/guides/plan-comparison): ZIP code to plan comparison table
- [ESIID Lookup Guide](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/guides/esiid-lookup): Address to ESIID to TDSP to plans
- [Featured Plans Guide](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/guides/featured-plans): Display curated plan recommendations
- [Pricing Guide](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/guides/pricing): Calculate prices and generate price charts
- [Tracking Links Guide](https://partner.comparepower.com/developers/guides/tracking-links): Send traffic to comparison or checkout via ref.comparepower.com and earn commissions with 30-day last-touch attribution

## Optional

- [Get Started](https://partner.comparepower.com/contact): Earn commissions on signups through your integration (free, 5 minutes)
